name: Midara ni Ochiru, Saiai Kanojo
original_name: 淫らに堕ちる、最愛彼女
source:
He feels her warmth in the dimly lit room.
Their gazes and fingertips entangle.
By his side, she smiles.
Their feelings... and bodies had been connected.
It was a moment of dream-like joy.

... So then, why?
... It was me who ought to have been there.
My childhood friend that I loved falls into indecency by the hands of my best friend...

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/062/story.html]official page[/url]]
translation:
昏暗的房间里，他感受到了她的温暖。
他们的目光和指尖纠缠在一起。
在他身边，她微笑着。
他们的感情……和身体已经相连。
那是一段梦幻般的喜悦时刻。

……那么，为什么呢？
……应该是我在场。
我所爱的青梅竹马，被我最好的朋友手下猥亵了……

[翻译自[url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/062/story.html]官方页面[/url]]
